title: Dispatch done-criteria: commit+push; orchestrator lane-gates
content: Dispatched-code done-criteria is commit+push, not local gates. Never brief a bro to run cargo/nextest in a fresh local worktree (cold target turns it into a 20+ minute full-dependency compile plus syspolicyd churn); the orchestrator runs all gates lane-side via `lane-run.sh --ref`, and steers corrections with bro_resume to the original author.
